title: Part 2 — a person who influenced you
description: キューカード形式（準備 1 分 → スピーチ 2 分）

tasks.label: Part 2 (Cue Card)
tasks.prompt:
Describe a person who influenced you.
You should say:
・who this person is
・how you first met or came to know this person
・what influence this person had on you
and explain why this person’s influence was important to you.
tasks.material:
You will have to talk about the topic for one or two minutes. You have one minute to think about what you are going to say. You can make some notes to help you if you wish. 
（訳）これから一つの話題について１〜２分話してもらいます。初めに1分程度考える時間をとります。その際メモをしても構いません。

sampleAnswers.label: Band 5.5
sampleAnswers.text:
Um, I’d like to talk about a person who influenced me a lot, uh, and that person is my high school English teacher.

I first met her when I was about sixteen years old, um, when I started high school. At that time, I wasn’t very interested in studying English, and I thought it was, uh, quite difficult and boring.

But she taught English in a very friendly way. For example, she often talked to us in English, uh, even outside the classroom, and she always encouraged us when we made mistakes. Because of that, um, I didn’t feel so scared of speaking English anymore.

Also, she told me that English is not just for exams, but for communication with people around the world. Uh, this idea really changed my attitude toward learning English. I started watching movies in English and listening to English songs, you know, in my free time.

So, um, the reason why her influence was important to me is that she helped me become more confident. Because of her, uh, I now feel more positive about using English, and it has helped me in my studies and daily life.

sampleAnswers.label: Band 6.5
sampleAnswers.text:
Well, I’d like to talk about a person who influenced me, and that is my high school English teacher.

I first met her when I entered high school, so I was around sixteen years old. At that time, I wasn’t very confident in English, and honestly, I didn’t enjoy studying it very much.

However, the way she taught English was quite different from my previous teachers. She often encouraged us to speak English, even if we made mistakes, and she created a relaxed atmosphere in class. Because of this, I gradually became more comfortable using English.

She also explained that English is a tool for communication rather than just a subject for exams. This really changed how I thought about learning the language. After that, I started watching English movies and listening to English music in my free time.

So, the reason why her influence was important to me is that she helped me build confidence. Thanks to her, I now feel more motivated to use English, and it has had a positive effect on both my studies and daily life.

sampleAnswers.label: Band 7.5+
sampleAnswers.text:
I’d like to describe a person who had a strong influence on me, and that person is my high school English teacher.

I met her when I started high school, at a time when I lacked confidence in English and saw it mainly as a difficult school subject. I didn’t expect English to become something I would actually enjoy.

What made her influential was her approach to teaching. She consistently encouraged us to speak without worrying too much about mistakes and focused more on communication than accuracy. This created a supportive learning environment, which helped me become more willing to express myself in English.

She also made me realise that English is a practical skill that allows people to connect across cultures, not just an exam requirement. As a result, I became more independent in my learning, watching films in English and listening to English music outside class.

Her influence was important because it changed my mindset. Instead of seeing English as a source of stress, I began to see it as an opportunity. This shift in attitude has stayed with me and continues to benefit me both academically and in everyday situations.
